task_description: Fix the d3d11.dll proxy DLL that causes GW2 to show 'Unable to initialize 3D output'. Three root causes: (1) Heavy dependencies (Tesseract, leptonica, sqlite3) linked at load time cause LoadLibrary failure, (2) Present hook only in D3D11CreateDeviceAndSwapChain which GW2 does not call, (3) DllMain does too much. Solution: separate OCR/translation into a runtime-loaded DLL, hook Present via dummy SwapChain in D3D11CreateDevice, make DllMain minimal.
